title: ComSim: Building Scalable Real-World Robot Data Generation via Compositional Simulation
summary: Recent advancements in foundational models, such as large language models and world models, have greatly enhanced the capabilities of robotics, enabling robots to autonomously perform complex tasks. However, acquiring large-scale, high-quality training data for robotics remains a challenge, as it often requires substantial manual effort and is limited in its coverage of diverse real-world environments. To address this, we propose a novel hybrid approach called Compositional Simulation, which combines classical simulation and neural simulation to generate accurate action-video pairs while maintaining real-world consistency. Our approach utilizes a closed-loop real-sim-real data augmentation pipeline, leveraging a small amount of real-world data to generate diverse, large-scale training datasets that cover a broader spectrum of real-world scenarios. We train a neural simulator to transform classical simulation videos into real-world representations, improving the accuracy of policy models trained in real-world environments. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the sim2real domain gap, resulting in higher success rates in real-world policy model training. Our approach offers a scalable solution for generating robust training data and bridging the gap between simulated and real-world robotics.
tldr: The paper introduces Compositional Simulation (ComSim), a hybrid approach using classical and neural simulation to generate diverse, realistic robot training data through a closed-loop real-sim-real pipeline, aimed at reducing the sim2real gap.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为组合模拟（ComSim）的混合方法，通过结合经典模拟和神经模拟，利用闭环的真实-模拟-真实数据增强流程，生成多样化的真实机器人训练数据，旨在减少模拟与现实的差距。
summary_zh: 近年来，基础模型（如大规模语言模型与世界模型）的进步显著提升了机器人能力，使其能够自主执行复杂任务。然而，获取大规模、高质量的机器人训练数据仍面临挑战，现有方法通常需要大量人工操作，且难以覆盖多样化真实环境。为此，我们提出一种名为“组合仿真”的混合方法，通过融合经典仿真与神经仿真技术，在保持真实世界一致性的同时生成精确的动作-视频对。该方法采用闭环式“真实-仿真-真实”数据增强流程，利用少量真实世界数据生成覆盖更广泛场景的大规模多样化训练数据集。我们训练了一个神经仿真器，将经典仿真视频转换为真实世界表征，从而提升在真实环境中训练的策略模型的准确性。大量实验表明，该方法能显著缩小仿真与现实间的领域差距，使真实世界策略模型训练的成功率大幅提高。本工作为生成鲁棒训练数据、弥合仿真与真实机器人之间的差距提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Learning Racket-Ball Bounce Dynamics Across Diverse Rubbers for Robotic Table Tennis
summary: Accurate dynamic models for racket-ball bounces are essential for reliable control in robotic table tennis. Existing models typically assume simple linear models and are restricted to inverted rubbers, limiting their ability to generalize across the wide variety of rackets encountered in practice. In this work, we present a unified framework for modeling ball-racket interactions across 10 racket configurations featuring different rubber types, including inverted, anti-spin, and pimpled surfaces. Using a high-speed multi-camera setup with spin estimation, we collect a dataset of racket-ball bounces spanning a broad range of incident velocities and spins. We show that key physical parameters governing rebound, such as the Coefficient of Restitution and tangential impulse response, vary systematically with the impact state and differ significantly across rubbers. To capture these effects while preserving physical interpretability, we estimate the parameters of an impulse-based contact model using Gaussian Processes conditioned on the ball's incoming velocity and spin. The resulting model provides both accurate predictions and uncertainty estimations. Compared to the constant parameter baselines, our approach reduces post-impact velocity and spin prediction errors across all racket types, with the largest improvements observed for nonstandard rubbers. Furthermore, the GP-based model enables online identification of racket dynamics with few observations during gameplay.
tldr: This paper introduces a unified framework for learning a physically interpretable, data-driven model of ball-racket bounce dynamics across diverse rubber types, improving prediction accuracy for robotic table tennis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个统一框架，用于学习跨不同胶皮类型、具有物理可解释性的数据驱动球拍-球碰撞动力学模型，提高了机器人乒乓球控制的预测准确性。
summary_zh: 精确的球拍-乒乓球碰撞动态模型是实现机器人乒乓球可靠控制的关键。现有模型通常假设简单的线性模型，且仅限于反胶球拍，限制了其在实际应用中处理多样化球拍的泛化能力。本研究提出了一个统一框架，用于模拟10种不同胶皮配置（包括反胶、防弧胶和颗粒胶）的球拍与球的相互作用。通过配备旋转估计功能的高速多摄像头系统，我们收集了涵盖广泛入射速度与旋转状态的球拍-球碰撞数据集。研究表明，控制反弹的关键物理参数（如恢复系数和切向冲量响应）随碰撞状态呈现系统性变化，且在不同胶皮类型间存在显著差异。为在保持物理可解释性的同时捕捉这些效应，我们采用以球体入射速度与旋转为条件的高斯过程，对基于冲量的接触模型参数进行估计。所得模型不仅能提供精确预测，还能进行不确定性评估。与固定参数基线模型相比，我们的方法在所有球拍类型上均降低了碰撞后速度与旋转的预测误差，其中非标准胶皮的改进最为显著。此外，基于高斯过程的模型能够通过少量比赛观测数据，实现对球拍动力学的在线识别。

title: CLAW: Composable Language-Annotated Whole-body Motion Generation
summary: Training language-conditioned whole-body controllers for humanoid robots requires large-scale datasets pairing motion trajectories with natural-language descriptions. Existing approaches based on motion capture are costly and limited in diversity, while text-to-motion generative models produce purely kinematic outputs that are not guaranteed to be physically feasible. Therefore, we present CLAW, an interactive web-based pipeline for scalable generation of language-annotated whole-body motion data for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot. CLAW treats the motion modes of a kinematic planner as composable building blocks, each parameterized by movement, heading, speed, pelvis height and duration, and provides two browser-based interfaces -- a real-time keyboard mode and a timeline-based sequence editor -- for exploratory and batch data collection. A low-level whole-body controller tracks the planner's kinematic references in MuJoCo simulation, producing physically grounded trajectories recorded at 50Hz. Simultaneously, a deterministic template-based annotation engine generates diverse natural-language descriptions at multiple stylistic registers for every segment and for the full trajectory. We release the system as open source to support scalable generation of language-motion paired data for humanoid robot learning.
tldr: CLAW introduces an interactive web-based pipeline for scalable generation of language-annotated, physically feasible whole-body motion data for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, addressing data scarcity for training language-conditioned controllers.
tldr_zh: CLAW 提出了一种交互式、基于网络的流水线，用于为 Unitree G1 人形机器人可扩展地生成语言标注的、物理可行的全身运动数据，以解决训练语言条件控制器的数据稀缺问题。
summary_zh: 训练类人机器人的语言条件化全身控制器需要大规模数据集，将运动轨迹与自然语言描述配对。现有基于动作捕捉的方法成本高昂且多样性有限，而文本到动作生成模型仅产生纯运动学输出，无法保证物理可实现性。因此，我们提出了CLAW——一个基于Web的交互式流水线系统，用于为Unitree G1类人机器人可扩展地生成语言标注的全身运动数据。CLAW将运动规划器的动作模式视为可组合的构建模块，每个模块由移动方式、朝向、速度、骨盆高度和持续时间等参数定义，并提供两种基于浏览器的交互界面：实时键盘模式和基于时间线的序列编辑器，分别支持探索式和批量数据收集。底层全身控制器在MuJoCo仿真中跟踪规划器的运动学参考，生成以50Hz记录的物理可行轨迹。同时，基于确定性模板的标注引擎为每个运动片段及完整轨迹生成多种风格的自然语言描述。我们将该系统开源发布，以支持类人机器人学习中语言-运动配对数据的可扩展生成。

title: Simulator Adaptation for Sim-to-Real Learning of Legged Locomotion via Proprioceptive Distribution Matching
summary: Simulation trained legged locomotion policies often exhibit performance loss on hardware due to dynamics discrepancies between the simulator and the real world, highlighting the need for approaches that adapt the simulator itself to better match hardware behavior. Prior work typically quantify these discrepancies through precise, time-aligned matching of joint and base trajectories. This process requires motion capture, privileged sensing, and carefully controlled initial conditions. We introduce a practical alternative based on proprioceptive distribution matching, which compares hardware and simulation rollouts as distributions of joint observations and actions, eliminating the need for time alignment or external sensing. Using this metric as a black-box objective, we explore adapting simulator dynamics through parameter identification, action-delta models, and residual actuator models. Our approach matches the parameter recovery and policy-performance gains of privileged state-matching baselines across extensive sim-to-sim ablations on the Go2 quadruped. Real-world experiments demonstrate substantial drift reduction using less than five minutes of hardware data, even for a challenging two-legged walking behavior. These results demonstrate that proprioceptive distribution matching provides a practical and effective route to simulator adaptation for sim-to-real transfer of learned legged locomotion.
tldr: This paper presents a method for adapting simulation parameters to improve sim-to-real transfer of legged locomotion policies by matching the distribution of proprioceptive observations between hardware and simulation, eliminating the need for motion capture or time-aligned data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过匹配硬件与仿真中本体感觉观测的分布来改进腿式运动策略从仿真到真实世界迁移的仿真器参数适配方法，无需动作捕捉或时间对齐数据。
summary_zh: 摘要：基于模拟训练的四足运动策略在硬件上常因模拟器与真实世界间的动力学差异而出现性能下降，这凸显了需要通过调整模拟器以更好地匹配硬件行为的方法。以往研究通常通过精确时间对齐的关节与基座轨迹匹配来量化这些差异，但该过程需要运动捕捉系统、特权传感器及受控的初始条件。我们提出一种基于本体感知分布匹配的实用替代方案，将硬件与模拟器的运行数据视为关节观测与动作的分布进行比较，从而无需时间对齐或外部传感。利用此指标作为黑箱优化目标，我们探索通过参数辨识、动作增量模型和残差执行器模型来调整模拟器动力学。在Go2四足机器人上进行的模拟到模拟消融实验中，我们的方法在参数恢复和策略性能提升方面达到了与特权状态匹配基线相当的效果。真实世界实验表明，即使对于具有挑战性的双足行走行为，仅使用不到五分钟的硬件数据即可显著减少漂移现象。这些结果证明，本体感知分布匹配为学习型四足运动的模拟到现实迁移提供了一条实用且有效的模拟器自适应路径。

title: Disentangled Point Diffusion for Precise Object Placement
summary: Recent advances in robotic manipulation have highlighted the effectiveness of learning from demonstration. However, while end-to-end policies excel in expressivity and flexibility, they struggle both in generalizing to novel object geometries and in attaining a high degree of precision. An alternative, object-centric approach frames the task as predicting the placement pose of the target object, providing a modular decomposition of the problem. Building on this goal-prediction paradigm, we propose TAX-DPD, a hierarchical, disentangled point diffusion framework that achieves state-of-the-art performance in placement precision, multi-modal coverage, and generalization to variations in object geometries and scene configurations. We model global scene-level placements through a novel feed-forward Dense Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) that yields a spatially dense prior over global placements; we then model the local object-level configuration through a novel disentangled point cloud diffusion module that separately diffuses the object geometry and the placement frame, enabling precise local geometric reasoning. Interestingly, we demonstrate that our point cloud diffusion achieves substantially higher accuracy than a prior approach based on SE(3)-diffusion, even in the context of rigid object placement. We validate our approach across a suite of challenging tasks in simulation and in the real-world on high-precision industrial insertion tasks. Furthermore, we present results on a cloth-hanging task in simulation, indicating that our framework can further relax assumptions on object rigidity.
tldr: A hierarchical, disentangled point diffusion framework for precise object placement in robotic manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art precision and generalization to novel object geometries and scene configurations.
tldr_zh: 一种用于机器人操作中精确物体放置的分层解耦点云扩散框架，在放置精度、多模态覆盖以及对新物体几何和场景配置的泛化方面达到最先进水平。
summary_zh: 近期机器人操作领域的研究进展凸显了从示范中学习的有效性。然而，尽管端到端策略在表现力和灵活性方面表现突出，但其在泛化至新物体几何形态及实现高精度操作方面仍存在困难。一种以物体为中心的方法将任务重构为预测目标物体的放置位姿，从而提供了问题的模块化分解框架。基于这种目标预测范式，我们提出TAX-DPD——一种层次化、解耦的点云扩散框架，该框架在放置精度、多模态覆盖能力以及泛化至不同物体几何形态和场景配置方面均达到业界领先水平。我们通过新型前馈式稠密高斯混合模型对全局场景级放置进行建模，该模型能生成覆盖全局放置的空间稠密先验分布；随后通过创新的解耦点云扩散模块对局部物体级配置进行建模，该模块可分别对物体几何结构与放置坐标系进行扩散处理，从而实现精确的局部几何推理。值得注意的是，实验表明即使是在刚性物体放置任务中，我们的点云扩散方法相较于基于SE(3)扩散的现有方案也能实现显著更高的精度。我们通过一系列仿真环境中的挑战性任务及高精度工业插装场景的实物实验验证了该方法的有效性。此外，我们在仿真环境中展示了布料悬挂任务的测试结果，表明该框架能够进一步放宽对物体刚性的假设约束。

title: Identifying Inductive Biases for Robot Co-Design
summary: Co-designing a robot's morphology and control can ensure synergistic interactions between them, prevalent in biological organisms. However, co-design is a high-dimensional search problem. To make this search tractable, we need a systematic method for identifying inductive biases tailored to its structure. In this paper, we analyze co-design landscapes for soft locomotion and manipulation tasks and identify three patterns that are consistent across regions of their co-design spaces. We observe that within regions of co-design space, quality varies along a low-dimensional manifold. Higher-quality regions exhibit variations spread across more dimensions, while tightly coupling morphology and control. We leverage these insights to devise an efficient co-design algorithm. Since the precise instantiation of this structure varies across tasks and is not known a priori, our algorithm infers it from information gathered during search and adapts to each task's specific structure. This yields $36\%$ more improvement than benchmark algorithms. Moreover, our algorithm achieved more than two orders of magnitude in sample efficiency compared to these benchmark algorithms, demonstrating the effectiveness of leveraging inductive biases to co-design.
tldr: This paper proposes a method to identify and leverage task-specific inductive biases for co-designing robot morphology and control, focusing on soft locomotion and manipulation tasks, achieving significant improvements in sample efficiency and performance over benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，用于识别和利用任务特定的归纳偏差，以协同设计机器人形态和控制，专注于软体机器人的运动和操作任务，在样本效率和性能上相比基准方法取得了显著提升。
summary_zh: 协同设计机器人的形态与控制能够确保两者之间产生协同作用，这种现象在生物有机体中普遍存在。然而，协同设计是一个高维度的搜索问题。为了使这一搜索过程易于处理，我们需要一种系统化的方法，来识别专门针对其结构量身定制的归纳偏置。本文分析了软体移动与操作任务中的协同设计空间，并识别了在其协同设计空间的不同区域中普遍存在的三种模式。我们观察到，在协同设计空间的各区域内，设计质量沿低维流形变化。质量更高的区域表现出更多维度上的变化，同时将形态与控制紧密耦合。基于这些发现，我们设计出一种高效的协同设计算法。由于这一结构的具体实现方式因任务而异且无法预先知晓，我们的算法在搜索过程中根据收集到的信息推断其结构，并自适应地调整以匹配每个任务的具体特征。该算法相比基准算法取得了超过36%的性能提升。此外，在样本效率方面，我们的算法实现了超过两个数量级的提升，证明了利用归纳偏置进行协同设计的有效性。

title: StarVLA-$α$: Reducing Complexity in Vision-Language-Action Systems
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for building general-purpose robotic agents. However, the VLA landscape remains highly fragmented and complex: as existing approaches vary substantially in architectures, training data, embodiment configurations, and benchmark-specific engineering. In this work, we introduce StarVLA-$α$, a simple yet strong baseline designed to study VLA design choices under controlled conditions. StarVLA-$α$ deliberately minimizes architectural and pipeline complexity to reduce experimental confounders and enable systematic analysis. Specifically, we re-evaluate several key design axes, including action modeling strategies, robot-specific pretraining, and interface engineering. Across unified multi-benchmark training on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin, and RoboCasa, the same simple baseline remains highly competitive, indicating that a strong VLM backbone combined with minimal design is already sufficient to achieve strong performance without relying on additional architectural complexity or engineering tricks. Notably, our single generalist model outperforms $π_{0.5}$ by 20\% on the public real-world RoboChallenge benchmark. We expect StarVLA-$α$ to serve as a solid starting point for future research in the VLA regime. Code will be released at https://github.com/starVLA/starVLA.
tldr: Presents StarVLA-α, a simple baseline for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to study design choices in generalist robotic agents, achieving strong performance on multiple benchmarks with minimal complexity.
tldr_zh: 提出StarVLA-α，一个用于研究通用机器人智能体VLA模型设计的简单基准，以最小复杂性在多个基准上取得强劲性能。
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作模型近年来已成为构建通用机器人代理的一种有前景范式。然而，当前视觉语言动作模型领域仍呈现高度碎片化与复杂性：现有方法在架构设计、训练数据、具身配置以及针对特定基准的工程优化等方面存在显著差异。本研究提出StarVLA-α模型，这是一个设计简洁但性能强大的基线模型，旨在受控条件下系统研究视觉语言动作模型的设计选择。该模型通过刻意简化架构和流程复杂度，以降低实验干扰因素，实现可系统分析的设计验证。具体而言，我们重新评估了多个关键设计维度，包括动作建模策略、机器人专用预训练方法以及交互界面设计。在LIBERO、SimplerEnv、RoboTwin和RoboCasa四个基准数据集上进行统一多任务训练后，该简洁基线模型始终保持卓越竞争力，表明强大的视觉语言模型主干结合极简设计已足以实现优异性能，而无需依赖额外的架构复杂性或工程技巧。值得注意的是，在公开的真实世界RoboChallenge基准测试中，我们单一的通用模型性能超越π0.5模型达20%。我们期待StarVLA-α模型能为未来视觉语言动作模型领域的研究提供坚实起点。相关代码将在https://github.com/starVLA/starVLA发布。

title: Grounded World Model for Semantically Generalizable Planning
summary: In Model Predictive Control (MPC), world models predict the future outcomes of various action proposals, which are then scored to guide the selection of the optimal action. For visuomotor MPC, the score function is a distance metric between a predicted image and a goal image, measured in the latent space of a pretrained vision encoder like DINO and JEPA. However, it is challenging to obtain the goal image in advance of the task execution, particularly in new environments. Additionally, conveying the goal through an image offers limited interactivity compared with natural language. In this work, we propose to learn a Grounded World Model (GWM) in a vision-language-aligned latent space. As a result, each proposed action is scored based on how close its future outcome is to the task instruction, reflected by the similarity of embeddings. This approach transforms the visuomotor MPC to a VLA that surpasses VLM-based VLAs in semantic generalization. On the proposed WISER benchmark, GWM-MPC achieves a 87% success rate on the test set comprising 288 tasks that feature unseen visual signals and referring expressions, yet remain solvable with motions demonstrated during training. In contrast, traditional VLAs achieve an average success rate of 22%, even though they overfit the training set with a 90% success rate.
tldr: This paper proposes a Grounded World Model (GWM) learned in a vision-language-aligned latent space for Model Predictive Control, enabling robots to plan and execute tasks based on natural language instructions with strong semantic generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在视觉-语言对齐的潜在空间中学习的基础世界模型，用于模型预测控制，使机器人能够根据自然语言指令规划和执行任务，并具有很强的语义泛化能力。
summary_zh: 在模型预测控制（MPC）中，世界模型通过预测不同行动方案在未来产生的结果，并对这些结果进行评分以指导选择最优行动。对于视觉运动控制任务，评分函数通常采用预训练视觉编码器（如DINO和JEPA）的潜空间中，预测图像与目标图像之间的嵌入距离度量。然而，在实际任务执行前获取目标图像具有挑战性，尤其是在新环境中。此外，与自然语言相比，通过图像传递目标信息在交互性方面存在局限。本研究提出在视觉-语言对齐的潜空间中学习一个基于语义的世界模型（GWM）。通过对每个行动方案产生的未来结果，在嵌入空间中与任务指令的语义相似度进行评分，从而将视觉运动控制任务转化为视觉语言对齐的控制器。该方法在语义泛化能力上超越了基于视觉语言模型的传统方法。在提出的WISER基准测试中，GWM-MPC在包含288个任务的测试集上取得了87%的成功率，这些任务具有训练中未见的视觉信号和指代表达，但仍可通过训练演示的运动策略解决。相比之下，传统视觉语言对齐控制器虽然在训练集上达到90%的成功率，但在测试集上的平均成功率仅为22%。

title: LARY: A Latent Action Representation Yielding Benchmark for Generalizable Vision-to-Action Alignment
summary: While the shortage of explicit action data limits Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, human action videos offer a scalable yet unlabeled data source. A critical challenge in utilizing large-scale human video datasets lies in transforming visual signals into ontology-independent representations, known as latent actions. However, the capacity of latent action representation to derive robust control from visual observations has yet to be rigorously evaluated. We introduce the Latent Action Representation Yielding (LARY) Benchmark, a unified framework for evaluating latent action representations on both high-level semantic actions (what to do) and low-level robotic control (how to do). The comprehensively curated dataset encompasses over one million videos (1,000 hours) spanning 151 action categories, alongside 620K image pairs and 595K motion trajectories across diverse embodiments and environments. Our experiments reveal two crucial insights: (i) General visual foundation models, trained without any action supervision, consistently outperform specialized embodied latent action models. (ii) Latent-based visual space is fundamentally better aligned to physical action space than pixel-based space. These results suggest that general visual representations inherently encode action-relevant knowledge for physical control, and that semantic-level abstraction serves as a fundamentally more effective pathway from vision to action than pixel-level reconstruction.
tldr: Introduces LARY, a benchmark for evaluating latent action representations for vision-to-action alignment, using a large-scale dataset to show that general visual models outperform specialized embodied models and that latent spaces are better aligned to physical action than pixel spaces.
tldr_zh: 引入LARY基准，用于评估视觉到动作对齐的潜在动作表征，通过大规模数据集表明通用视觉模型优于专门的具身模型，且潜在空间比像素空间更对齐物理动作。
summary_zh: 显性动作数据的匮乏制约了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的发展，而人类行为视频则为模型训练提供了可扩展却无标注的数据源。利用大规模人类视频数据的关键挑战在于如何将视觉信号转化为独立于本体结构的表征形式，即潜在动作。然而，潜在动作表征能否从视觉观测中推导出稳健的控制策略，尚未得到严格验证。我们提出潜在动作表征性能基准（LARY），这是一个用于评估高层次语义动作（做什么）与低层次机器人控制（如何做）的统一框架。该基准数据集涵盖超过一百万段视频（总计1000小时），涉及151个动作类别，同时包含62万组图像对及59.5万条运动轨迹，覆盖多样化的机器人具身形态与环境场景。实验结果表明两个关键发现：（一）未经动作监督训练的通用视觉基础模型，其表现持续优于专门的具身潜在动作模型；（二）基于潜在表征的视觉空间较像素空间与物理动作空间具有更本质的对齐性。这些发现表明，通用视觉表征内在地编码了物理控制所需的行为相关知识，且语义层面的抽象构建了从视觉到动作的通道，其本质效能远超像素级重建方法。

title: AffordSim: A Scalable Data Generator and Benchmark for Affordance-Aware Robotic Manipulation
summary: Simulation-based data generation has become a dominant paradigm for training robotic manipulation policies, yet existing platforms do not incorporate object affordance information into trajectory generation. As a result, tasks requiring precise interaction with specific functional regions--grasping a mug by its handle, pouring from a cup's rim, or hanging a mug on a hook--cannot be automatically generated with semantically correct trajectories. We introduce AffordSim, the first simulation framework that integrates open-vocabulary 3D affordance prediction into the manipulation data generation pipeline. AffordSim uses our VoxAfford model, an open-vocabulary 3D affordance detector that enhances MLLM output tokens with multi-scale geometric features, to predict affordance maps on object point clouds, guiding grasp pose estimation toward task-relevant functional regions. Built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim with cross-embodiment support (Franka FR3, Panda, UR5e, Kinova), VLM-powered task generation, and novel domain randomization using DA3-based 3D Gaussian reconstruction from real photographs, AffordSim enables automated, scalable generation of affordance-aware manipulation data. We establish a benchmark of 50 tasks across 7 categories (grasping, placing, stacking, pushing/pulling, pouring, mug hanging, long-horizon composite) and evaluate 4 imitation learning baselines (BC, Diffusion Policy, ACT, Pi 0.5). Our results reveal that while grasping is largely solved (53-93% success), affordance-demanding tasks such as pouring into narrow containers (1-43%) and mug hanging (0-47%) remain significantly more challenging for current imitation learning methods, highlighting the need for affordance-aware data generation. Zero-shot sim-to-real experiments on a real Franka FR3 validate the transferability of the generated data.
tldr: This paper introduces AffordSim, a simulation framework and benchmark for generating affordance-aware robotic manipulation data, integrating 3D affordance prediction into the data generation pipeline. It evaluates imitation learning methods on challenging affordance-demanding tasks and demonstrates sim-to-real transfer on a physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 AffordSim，一个用于生成具身化操作数据的仿真框架和基准，它将 3D 可供性预测集成到数据生成流程中。该研究评估了模仿学习方法在具身化操作任务上的表现，并在真实机器人上验证了仿真到真实的迁移能力。
summary_zh: 基于仿真的数据生成已成为训练机器人操作策略的主流范式，但现有平台均未将物体可供性信息纳入轨迹生成过程。这导致需要与特定功能区域精确交互的任务——例如握持杯柄、从杯沿倾倒或将杯子悬挂于挂钩——无法自动生成语义正确的轨迹。本文提出AffordSim，首个将开放词汇3D可供性预测集成到操作数据生成流程的仿真框架。AffordSim采用我们提出的VoxAfford模型（一种通过多尺度几何特征增强多模态大语言模型输出标记的开放词汇3D可供性检测器），在物体点云上预测可供性热图，从而引导抓取姿态估计朝向任务相关的功能区域。该框架基于英伟达Isaac Sim构建，支持跨本体机器人（Franka FR3、Panda、UR5e、Kinova），具备视觉语言模型驱动的任务生成功能，并创新性地采用基于DA3从真实照片重建的3D高斯模型进行域随机化。AffordSim实现了可供性感知操作数据的自动化、规模化生成。我们建立了涵盖7大类任务（抓取、放置、堆叠、推/拉、倾倒、挂杯、长时程复合任务）的50项任务基准，评估了4种模仿学习方法（行为克隆、扩散策略、ACT、Pi 0.5）。结果表明：虽然抓取任务已基本解决（成功率53-93%），但对可供性敏感的任务（如向窄口容器倾倒（1-43%）和挂杯（0-47%））对现有模仿学习方法仍具显著挑战，这凸显了可供性感知数据生成的必要性。在真实Franka FR3机器人上进行的零样本仿真到现实迁移实验验证了生成数据的可迁移性。

title: DA-PTQ: Drift-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong potential for embodied AI, yet their deployment on resource-limited robots remains challenging due to high memory and computational demands. While Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides an efficient solution, directly applying PTQ to VLAs often results in severe performance degradation during sequential control. We identify temporal error accumulation as a key factor, where quantization perturbations at the vision-language-to-action interface are progressively amplified, leading to kinematic drift in executed trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Drift-Aware Post-Training Quantization (DA-PTQ), which formulates quantization as a drift-aware optimization problem over sequential decision processes. DA-PTQ consists of two components: (1) Cross-Space Representation Compensation, which mitigates structured distortions between multimodal representations and action space to improve action consistency, and (2) Motion-Driven Mixed-Precision Allocation, which assigns bit-widths by minimizing trajectory-level motion errors. Extensive experiments show that DA-PTQ significantly reduces kinematic drift and achieves comparable performance to full-precision models under low-bit settings, enabling practical deployment of VLAs on resource-limited robotic platforms.
tldr: Proposes a drift-aware post-training quantization method (DA-PTQ) to efficiently compress Vision-Language-Action models for deployment on resource-limited robotic platforms, addressing the issue of quantization-induced error accumulation that leads to kinematic drift in sequential control tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种漂移感知的训练后量化方法（DA-PTQ），用于高效压缩视觉-语言-动作模型，以在资源受限的机器人平台上部署，解决了量化误差累积导致连续控制任务中运动轨迹漂移的问题。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在具身人工智能领域展现出巨大潜力，但由于其高内存和计算需求，在资源受限的机器人上部署仍面临挑战。后训练量化技术虽能提供高效解决方案，但将其直接应用于VLA模型时，常导致顺序控制过程中性能严重下降。我们发现时间误差累积是核心问题：视觉-语言-动作界面的量化扰动会在连续决策中被逐步放大，最终引发执行轨迹的运动学漂移。为解决此问题，本文提出漂移感知后训练量化方法（DA-PTQ），将量化问题建模为针对序列决策过程的漂移感知优化问题。DA-PTQ包含两个核心组件：（1）跨空间表征补偿机制，通过缓解多模态表征与动作空间之间的结构化失真来提升动作一致性；（2）运动驱动混合精度分配策略，通过最小化轨迹层级运动误差来动态分配位宽。大量实验表明，DA-PTQ能显著降低运动学漂移，在低位宽设置下达到与全精度模型相当的性能，为VLA在资源受限机器人平台上的实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: WM-DAgger: Enabling Efficient Data Aggregation for Imitation Learning with World Models
summary: Imitation learning is a powerful paradigm for training robotic policies, yet its performance is limited by compounding errors: minor policy inaccuracies could drive robots into unseen out-of-distribution (OOD) states in the training set, where the policy could generate even bigger errors, leading to eventual failures. While the Data Aggregation (DAgger) framework tries to address this issue, its reliance on continuous human involvement severely limits scalability. In this paper, we propose WM-DAgger, an efficient data aggregation framework that leverages World Models to synthesize OOD recovery data without requiring human involvement. Specifically, we focus on manipulation tasks with an eye-in-hand robotic arm and only few-shot demonstrations. To avoid synthesizing misleading data and overcome the hallucination issues inherent to World Models, our framework introduces two key mechanisms: (1) a Corrective Action Synthesis Module that generates task-oriented recovery actions to prevent misleading supervision, and (2) a Consistency-Guided Filtering Module that discards physically implausible trajectories by anchoring terminal synthesized frames to corresponding real frames in expert demonstrations. We extensively validate WM-DAgger on multiple real-world robotic tasks. Results that our method significantly improves success rates, achieving a 93.3\% success rate in soft bag pushing with only five demonstrations. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/czs12354-xxdbd/WM-Dagger.
tldr: WM-DAgger is a data aggregation framework for robotic imitation learning that uses a World Model to generate synthetic out-of-distribution recovery data, reducing the need for human intervention and improving success rates on tasks like bag pushing.
tldr_zh: WM-DAgger 是一个用于机器人模仿学习的数据聚合框架，利用世界模型合成分布外恢复数据，减少对人类干预的需求，在袋装推动等任务中提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 模仿学习是一种训练机器人策略的强大范式，但其性能受限于复合误差：策略中的微小偏差可能导致机器人进入训练集中未见过的分布外状态，此时策略可能产生更大误差，最终导致任务失败。虽然数据聚合框架试图解决此问题，但其对持续人工干预的依赖严重限制了可扩展性。本文提出WM-DAgger，一种高效的数据聚合框架，其利用世界模型合成分布外恢复数据而无需人工参与。我们重点研究基于眼在手配置的机械臂操作任务，且仅需少量演示数据。为避免合成误导性数据并克服世界模型固有的幻觉问题，本框架引入两大核心机制：（1）纠正动作合成模块，生成面向任务的恢复动作以防止误导性监督；（2）一致性引导过滤模块，通过将末端合成帧锚定至专家演示中的对应真实帧，从而剔除物理不可信的轨迹。我们在多个真实世界机器人任务上对WM-DAgger进行了广泛验证。实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了成功率，在仅使用五次演示的软质包裹推动任务中达到93.3%的成功率。源代码已公开于https://github.com/czs12354-xxdbd/WM-Dagger。

title: CLASP: Closed-loop Asynchronous Spatial Perception for Open-vocabulary Desktop Object Grasping
summary: Robot grasping of desktop object is widely used in intelligent manufacturing, logistics, and agriculture.Although vision-language models (VLMs) show strong potential for robotic manipulation, their deployment in low-level grasping faces key challenges: scarce high-quality multimodal demonstrations, spatial hallucination caused by weak geometric grounding, and the fragility of open-loop execution in dynamic environments. To address these challenges, we propose Closed-Loop Asynchronous Spatial Perception(CLASP), a novel asynchronous closed-loop framework that integrates multimodal perception, logical reasoning, and state-reflective feedback. First, we design a Dual-Pathway Hierarchical Perception module that decouples high-level semantic intent from geometric grounding. The design guides the output of the inference model and the definite action tuples, reducing spatial illusions. Second, an Asynchronous Closed-Loop Evaluator is implemented to compare pre- and post-execution states, providing text-based diagnostic feedback to establish a robust error-correction loop and improving the vulnerability of traditional open-loop execution in dynamic environments. Finally, we design a scalable multi-modal data engine that automatically synthesizes high-quality spatial annotations and reasoning templates from real and synthetic scenes without human teleoperation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an 87.0% overall success rate. Notably, the proposed framework exhibits remarkable generalization across diverse objects, bridging the sim-to-real gap and providing exceptional robustness in geometrically challenging categories and cluttered scenarios.
tldr: CLASP is a framework for robot grasping that uses a closed-loop, asynchronous perception system to improve geometric grounding and robustness in open-vocabulary desktop object manipulation, achieving high success rates.
tldr_zh: CLASP 是一个用于机器人抓取的框架，采用闭环异步感知系统来提高开放词汇桌面物体操作中的几何基础和鲁棒性，实现了高成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人抓取桌面物体广泛应用于智能制造、物流及农业领域。尽管视觉语言模型在机器人操作中展现出强大潜力，但其在底层抓取任务中的部署仍面临关键挑战：高质量多模态示范数据稀缺、弱几何基础导致的空间幻觉问题，以及动态环境中开环执行的脆弱性。为解决这些挑战，我们提出闭环异步空间感知框架——一种集成了多模态感知、逻辑推理与状态反射反馈的新型异步闭环框架。首先，我们设计了双通路层次感知模块，将高层语义意图与几何基础解耦。该设计通过引导推理模型输出确定性的动作元组，有效降低了空间幻觉现象。其次，我们构建了异步闭环评估器，通过对比执行前后的状态差异生成文本诊断反馈，从而建立稳健的纠错闭环机制，显著改善了传统开环系统在动态环境中的脆弱性。最后，我们开发了可扩展的多模态数据引擎，能够在不依赖人工遥操作的情况下，从真实与合成场景中自动生成高质量的空间标注与推理模板。大量实验表明，该方法显著优于现有基线模型，整体成功率达到了87.0%。值得注意的是，所提出的框架在不同物体间展现出卓越的泛化能力，成功弥合了仿真与现实的差距，在几何结构复杂的物体类别和杂乱场景中均表现出优异的鲁棒性。

title: Learning to Forget -- Hierarchical Episodic Memory for Lifelong Robot Deployment
summary: Robots must verbalize their past experiences when users ask "Where did you put my keys?" or "Why did the task fail?" Yet maintaining life-long episodic memory (EM) from continuous multimodal perception quickly exceeds storage limits and makes real-time query impractical, calling for selective forgetting that adapts to users' notions of relevance. We present H$^2$-EMV, a framework enabling humanoids to learn what to remember through user interaction. Our approach incrementally constructs hierarchical EM, selectively forgets using language-model-based relevance estimation conditioned on learned natural-language rules, and updates these rules given user feedback about forgotten details. Evaluations on simulated household tasks and 20.5-hour-long real-world recordings from ARMAR-7 demonstrate that H$^2$-EMV maintains question-answering accuracy while reducing memory size by 45% and query-time compute by 35%. Critically, performance improves over time - accuracy increases 70% in second-round queries by adapting to user-specific priorities - demonstrating that learned forgetting enables scalable, personalized EM for long-term human-robot collaboration.
tldr: A framework for humanoid robots to build and maintain hierarchical episodic memory through learned forgetting, adapting to user-specific relevance via language-model-based rules and user feedback, enabling efficient long-term memory for question-answering and collaboration.
tldr_zh: 提出一种人形机器人框架，通过基于语言模型的相关性估计和用户反馈，学习选择性遗忘，构建并维护层次化情景记忆，以实现高效、个性化的长期记忆问答和协作。
summary_zh: 当用户询问"我的钥匙放在哪里？"或"任务为何失败？"时，机器人需要能够描述其过往经历。然而，基于持续多模态感知构建终身情景记忆会迅速超出存储限制，导致实时查询难以实现，这要求系统能够根据用户相关性概念进行选择性遗忘。我们提出H$^2$-EMV框架，使人形机器人通过用户交互学习记忆策略。该方法渐进式构建分层情景记忆，基于语言模型相关性评估（以前习得的自然语言规则为条件）进行选择性遗忘，并根据用户对遗忘细节的反馈更新规则。在模拟家庭任务和ARMAR-7机器人20.5小时真实场景记录上的评估表明，H$^2$-EMV在保持问答准确率的同时，将内存占用降低45%，查询计算量减少35%。关键在于，系统性能随时间持续提升——通过适应用户特定优先级，第二轮查询准确率提高70%——证明习得性遗忘机制能够为长期人机协作提供可扩展的个性化情景记忆系统。

title: ViserDex: Visual Sim-to-Real for Robust Dexterous In-hand Reorientation
summary: In-hand object reorientation requires precise estimation of the object pose to handle complex task dynamics. While RGB sensing offers rich semantic cues for pose tracking, existing solutions rely on multi-camera setups or costly ray tracing. We present a sim-to-real framework for monocular RGB in-hand reorientation that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to bridge the visual sim-to-real gap. Our key insight is performing domain randomization in the Gaussian representation space: by applying physically consistent, pre-rendering augmentations to 3D Gaussians, we generate photorealistic, randomized visual data for object pose estimation. The manipulation policy is trained using curriculum-based reinforcement learning with teacher-student distillation, enabling efficient learning of complex behaviors. Importantly, both perception and control models can be trained independently on consumer-grade hardware, eliminating the need for large compute clusters. Experiments show that the pose estimator trained with 3DGS data outperforms those trained using conventional rendering data in challenging visual environments. We validate the system on a physical multi-fingered hand equipped with an RGB camera, demonstrating robust reorientation of five diverse objects even under challenging lighting conditions. Our results highlight Gaussian splatting as a practical path for RGB-only dexterous manipulation. For videos of the hardware deployments and additional supplementary materials, please refer to the project website: https://rffr.leggedrobotics.com/works/viserdex/
tldr: This paper introduces ViserDex, a sim-to-real framework for monocular RGB in-hand reorientation using 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for visual domain randomization and curriculum-based reinforcement learning for control, validated on a physical multi-fingered hand.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ViserDex，一个用于单目RGB手中物体重定向的模拟到真实框架，利用3D高斯溅射进行视觉域随机化，并通过课程强化学习训练控制策略，在物理多指手上验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 手内物体重定向需要精确的物体姿态估计以处理复杂的任务动态。虽然RGB传感为姿态跟踪提供了丰富的语义线索，但现有解决方案依赖于多摄像头设置或成本高昂的光线追踪。我们提出了一种用于单目RGB手内重定向的仿真到现实框架，该框架集成了3D高斯泼溅技术（3DGS）以弥合视觉仿真到现实的差距。我们的核心见解是在高斯表示空间进行领域随机化：通过对3D高斯进行物理一致、预渲染的数据增强，我们为物体姿态估计生成具有照片级真实感的随机化视觉数据。操控策略通过基于课程的强化学习和师生蒸馏方法进行训练，从而高效学习复杂行为。重要的是，感知与控制模型均可在消费级硬件上独立训练，无需大型计算集群。实验表明，在具有挑战性的视觉环境中，使用3DGS数据训练的姿势估计器性能优于传统渲染数据训练的模型。我们在配备RGB摄像头的物理多指手上验证了该系统，证明即使是在复杂光照条件下，也能对五种不同物体实现稳定的重定向操作。我们的研究结果表明，高斯泼溅技术为纯RGB精确操控提供了一条实用路径。硬件部署视频及补充材料请参见项目网站：https://rffr.leggedrobotics.com/works/viserdex/

title: AIM: Intent-Aware Unified world action Modeling with Spatial Value Maps
summary: Pretrained video generation models provide strong priors for robot control, but existing unified world action models still struggle to decode reliable actions without substantial robot-specific training. We attribute this limitation to a structural mismatch: while video models capture how scenes evolve, action generation requires explicit reasoning about where to interact and the underlying manipulation intent. We introduce AIM, an intent-aware unified world action model that bridges this gap via an explicit spatial interface. Instead of decoding actions directly from future visual representations, AIM predicts an aligned spatial value map that encodes task-relevant interaction structure, enabling a control-oriented abstraction of future dynamics. Built on a pretrained video generation model, AIM jointly models future observations and value maps within a shared mixture-of-transformers architecture. It employs intent-causal attention to route future information to the action branch exclusively through the value representation. We further propose a self-distillation reinforcement learning stage that freezes the video and value branches and optimizes only the action head using dense rewards derived from projected value-map responses together with sparse task-level signals. To support training and evaluation, we construct a simulation dataset of 30K manipulation trajectories with synchronized multi-view observations, actions, and value-map annotations. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark show that AIM achieves a 94.0% average success rate, significantly outperforming prior unified world action baselines. Notably, the improvement is more pronounced in long-horizon and contact-sensitive manipulation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of explicit spatial-intent modeling as a bridge between visual world modeling and robot control.
tldr: This paper introduces AIM, an intent-aware unified world action model for robotic manipulation. It uses spatial value maps to bridge video generation models with robot control, achieving high success rates on long-horizon and contact-sensitive tasks in a simulation benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AIM，一种用于机器人操作的意图感知统一世界动作模型。它通过空间价值图在视频生成模型与机器人控制之间架起桥梁，在仿真基准测试中，尤其在长时程和接触敏感的任务上取得了很高的成功率。
summary_zh: 预训练视频生成模型为机器人控制提供了强大的先验信息，但现有的统一世界动作模型在缺乏大量机器人专用训练时，仍难以解码出可靠动作。我们认为这一局限源于结构错配：视频模型虽能捕捉场景演变规律，但动作生成需对交互位置与底层操作意图进行显式推理。为此，我们提出了意图感知的统一世界动作模型AIM，它通过显式空间接口弥合了这一鸿沟。该模型不直接从未视觉表征解码动作，而是预测编码了任务相关交互结构的对齐空间价值图，从而实现对未来动态的面向控制的抽象表达。AIM基于预训练视频生成模型构建，在共享的混合变换器架构中联合建模未来观测值与价值图，并采用意图因果注意力机制，确保未来信息仅通过价值表征路由至动作分支。我们进一步提出了自蒸馏强化学习阶段：冻结视频与价值分支，仅利用投影价值图响应生成的稠密奖励与稀疏任务级信号优化动作头。为支持训练与评估，我们构建了包含3万条操作轨迹的仿真数据集，涵盖同步多视角观测、动作及价值图标注。在RoboTwin 2.0基准测试中，AIM实现了94.0%的平均成功率，显著优于现有统一世界动作基线方法。值得注意的是，该模型在长时域和接触敏感型操作任务中表现提升尤为显著，证明了显式空间意图建模作为视觉世界模型与机器人控制桥梁的有效性。

title: Federated Single-Agent Robotics: Multi-Robot Coordination Without Intra-Robot Multi-Agent Fragmentation
summary: As embodied robots move toward fleet-scale operation, multi-robot coordination is becoming a central systems challenge. Existing approaches often treat this as motivation for increasing internal multi-agent decomposition within each robot. We argue for a different principle: multi-robot coordination does not require intra-robot multi-agent fragmentation. Each robot should remain a single embodied agent with its own persistent runtime, local policy scope, capability state, and recovery authority, while coordination emerges through federation across robots at the fleet level. We present Federated Single-Agent Robotics (FSAR), a runtime architecture for multi-robot coordination built on single-agent robot runtimes. Each robot exposes a governed capability surface rather than an internally fragmented agent society. Fleet coordination is achieved through shared capability registries, cross-robot task delegation, policy-aware authority assignment, trust-scoped interaction, and layered recovery protocols. We formalize key coordination relations including authority delegation, inter-robot capability requests, local-versus-fleet recovery boundaries, and hierarchical human supervision, and describe a fleet runtime architecture supporting shared Embodied Capability Module (ECM) discovery, contract-aware cross-robot coordination, and fleet-level governance. We evaluate FSAR on representative multi-robot coordination scenarios against decomposition-heavy baselines. Results show statistically significant gains in governance locality (d=2.91, p<.001 vs. centralized control) and recovery containment (d=4.88, p<.001 vs. decomposition-heavy), while reducing authority conflicts and policy violations across all scenarios. Our results support the view that the path from embodied agents to embodied fleets is better served by federation across coherent robot runtimes than by fragmentation within them.
tldr: This paper introduces FSAR, a novel multi-robot coordination architecture where each robot remains a single, coherent agent with local authority, and coordination is achieved through a federated fleet runtime, demonstrating improved governance and recovery.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了FSAR，一种多机器人协调架构，其中每个机器人保持为具有本地权限的单一智能体，并通过联邦式的机群运行时实现协调，证明了其在治理和恢复方面的改进。
summary_zh: 随着实体机器人向规模化集群运作发展，多机器人协调正成为核心系统挑战。现有方法常将此视为增强各机器人内部多智能体分解的动因，但我们主张采用不同原则：多机器人协调并不要求机器人内部的多智能体碎片化。每个机器人应保持为单一实体智能体，拥有独立的持续运行时、本地策略范围、能力状态与恢复权限，而协调通过集群层面的跨机器人联合机制实现。本文提出联邦式单智能体机器人（FSAR）架构——一种基于单智能体机器人运行时的多机器人协调运行时架构。每个机器人对外提供受治理的能力接口，而非内部碎片化的智能体集合。集群协调通过共享能力注册表、跨机器人任务委托、策略感知的权限分配、信任域交互及分层恢复协议实现。我们形式化定义了关键协调关系，包括权限委托、跨机器人能力请求、本地与集群恢复边界以及分层人工监督，并描述了支持共享实体能力模块（ECM）发现、合约感知的跨机器人协调及集群级治理的运行时架构。通过代表性多机器人协调场景与强分解基线方法的对比评估，FSAR在治理局部性（d=2.91，p<.001，相较于集中控制）和恢复隔离性（d=4.88，p<.001，相较于强分解方法）上均取得统计学显著提升，同时在所有场景中减少了权限冲突与策略违规。实验结果表明：从实体智能体迈向实体集群的道路，更适合通过协调一致的机器人运行时之间的联邦机制实现，而非依赖其内部碎片化设计。

title: ScoRe-Flow: Complete Distributional Control via Score-Based Reinforcement Learning for Flow Matching
summary: Flow Matching (FM) policies have emerged as an efficient backbone for robotic control, offering fast and expressive action generation that underpins recent large-scale embodied AI systems. However, FM policies trained via imitation learning inherit the limitations of demonstration data; surpassing suboptimal behaviors requires reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning. Recent methods convert deterministic flows into stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with learnable noise injection, enabling exploration and tractable likelihoods, but such noise-only control can compromise training efficiency when demonstrations already provide strong priors. We observe that modulating the drift via the score function, i.e., the gradient of log-density, steers exploration toward high-probability regions, improving stability. The score admits a closed-form expression from the velocity field, requiring no auxiliary networks. Based on this, we propose ScoRe-Flow, a score-based RL fine-tuning method that combines drift modulation with learned variance prediction to achieve decoupled control over the mean and variance of stochastic transitions. Experiments demonstrate that ScoRe-Flow achieves 2.4x faster convergence than flow-based SOTA on D4RL locomotion tasks and up to 5.4% higher success rates on Robomimic and Franka Kitchen manipulation tasks.
tldr: ScoRe-Flow is a score-based reinforcement learning method that fine-tunes Flow Matching policies for robotic control, enabling efficient exploration and improved performance on locomotion and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: ScoRe-Flow 是一种基于分数的强化学习方法，用于微调机器人控制中的流匹配策略，可实现高效探索，并在运动和操作任务上获得更高性能。
summary_zh: 流匹配策略已成为机器人控制的高效基础架构，其快速且富有表现力的动作生成能力支撑了近期大规模具身智能系统的发展。然而，通过模仿学习训练的流匹配策略继承了示范数据的局限性；要超越次优行为需要强化学习微调。现有方法将确定性流转换为具有可学习噪声注入的随机微分方程，实现了探索性和可处理的似然估计，但当示范数据已提供强先验时，仅依赖噪声控制的方案可能影响训练效率。我们观察到，通过得分函数（即对数概率密度的梯度）调节漂移项，能够引导探索朝向高概率区域，从而提升稳定性。该得分可由速度场直接推导出闭式表达式，无需额外网络。基于此，我们提出ScoRe-Flow——一种基于得分的强化学习微调方法，通过结合漂移调制与学习型方差预测，实现对随机转移过程均值与方差的解耦控制。实验表明，在D4RL运动控制任务中，ScoRe-Flow相比基于流的当前最优方法收敛速度提升2.4倍；在Robomimic与Franka Kitchen操作任务中，成功率最高提升5.4%。

title: Ro-SLM: Onboard Small Language Models for Robot Task Planning and Operation Code Generation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide robots with contextual reasoning abilities to comprehend human instructions. Yet, current LLM-enabled robots typically depend on cloud-based models or high-performance computing infrastructure, which limit their deployment on robots under unreliable internet environments or with constrained computational resources, such as UAVs and small ground vehicles. Thus, deploying fine-tuned small language models (SLMs) that support onboard deployment offers a promising alternative. This paper introduces Ro-SLM, a framework that enables reliable SLM-driven robot operation by distilling LLMs' knowledge and reasoning. Ro-SLM starts from dataset synthesis by leveraging LLMs to generate diverse task instructions, produce corresponding ground truth code with minimal human assistance, and augment instructions into real-world application scenarios. Ro-SLM is then fine-tuned with the dataset, in which LLM serves as a reward function to guide the training. Extensive experiments on UAV operation tasks demonstrate that Ro-SLM improves the performance of SLM from being incapable of supporting robotic task planning and code generation to achieving performance that approaches LLM.
tldr: This paper introduces Ro-SLM, a framework for fine-tuning small language models (SLMs) to run on robots for task planning and operation code generation, using knowledge distillation from LLMs and demonstrating performance on UAV operation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Ro-SLM框架，用于微调小型语言模型（SLM）在机器人上运行，以进行任务规划和操作代码生成，通过大语言模型（LLM）的知识蒸馏实现，并在无人机操作任务中验证了性能。
summary_zh: 近年来，大规模语言模型（LLM）的发展为机器人提供了理解人类指令的上下文推理能力。然而，当前依赖LLM的机器人通常需要基于云端的模型或高性能计算基础设施，这在不可靠的网络环境或计算资源受限的设备（如无人机和小型地面车辆）上部署时面临限制。因此，部署经过微调、可支持机载应用的小型语言模型（SLM）成为一种有前景的替代方案。本文提出Ro-SLM框架，该框架通过提炼LLM的知识与推理能力，实现了由SLM驱动的可靠机器人操作。Ro-SLM首先利用LLM合成数据集，生成多样化的任务指令，并在最少人工干预下产出对应的真实代码，同时将指令扩展至现实应用场景。随后，Ro-SLM使用该数据集进行微调，其中LLM作为奖励函数来引导训练过程。在无人机操作任务上进行的大量实验表明，Ro-SLM显著提升了SLM的性能，使其从无法支持机器人任务规划与代码生成，提升到接近LLM的表现水平。

title: WARPED: Wrist-Aligned Rendering for Robot Policy Learning from Egocentric Human Demonstrations
summary: Recent advancements in learning from human demonstration have shown promising results in addressing the scalability and high cost of data collection required to train robust visuomotor policies. However, existing approaches are often constrained by a reliance on multiview camera setups, depth sensors, or custom hardware and are typically limited to policy execution from third-person or egocentric cameras. In this paper, we present WARPED, a framework designed to synthesize realistic wrist-view observations from human demonstration videos to facilitate the training of visuomotor policies using only monocular RGB data. With data collected from an egocentric RGB camera, our system leverages vision foundation models to initialize the interactive scene. A hand-object interaction pipeline is then employed to track the hand and manipulated object and retarget the trajectories to a robotic end-effector. Lastly, photo-realistic wrist-view observations are synthesized via Gaussian Splatting to directly train a robotic policy. We demonstrate that WARPED achieves success rates comparable to policies trained on teleoperated demonstration data for five tabletop manipulation tasks, while requiring 5-8x less data collection time.
tldr: Presents WARPED, a framework for synthesizing realistic wrist-view observations from monocular RGB human demonstration videos to train visuomotor robot manipulation policies, achieving comparable success to teleoperated data with less collection time.
tldr_zh: 提出WARPED框架，利用单目RGB人类演示视频合成逼真的腕部视角观测数据，用于训练机器人视觉运动策略，在五个桌面操作任务上达到与遥操作演示数据相当的成功率，且数据收集时间减少5-8倍。
summary_zh:
摘要：
近年来，基于人类示范的学习方法在解决训练鲁棒视动策略所需的数据可扩展性与高采集成本问题上取得了显著进展。然而，现有方法往往受限于对多视角摄像机、深度传感器或定制硬件的依赖，且通常仅支持从第三人称或第一人称摄像机视角执行策略。本文提出WARPED框架，该框架旨在通过人类示范视频合成逼真的腕部视角观测数据，从而仅使用单目RGB数据即可训练视动策略。我们的系统利用基础视觉模型初始化从第一人称RGB摄像机采集的交互场景，随后采用手-物交互管线追踪手部与操作物体的运动轨迹，并将其重定向至机器人末端执行器。最后，通过高斯点云渲染技术合成具有照片级真实感的腕部视角观测数据，直接用于机器人策略训练。实验表明，在五项桌面操作任务中，WARPED框架所训练的策略成功率与基于遥操作示范数据训练的策略相当，同时数据采集时间减少5-8倍。

title: Optimal Kinodynamic Motion Planning Through Anytime Bidirectional Heuristic Search with Tight Termination Condition
summary: This paper introduces Bidirectional Tight Informed Trees (BTIT*), an asymptotically optimal kinodynamic sampling-based motion planning algorithm that integrates an anytime bidirectional heuristic search (Bi-HS) and ensures the \emph{meet-in-the-middle} property (MMP) and optimality (MM-optimality). BTIT* is the first anytime MEET-style algorithm to utilize termination conditions that are efficient to evaluate and enable early termination \emph{on-the-fly} in batch-wise sampling-based motion planning. Experiments show that BTIT* achieves strongly faster time-to-first-solution and improved convergence than representative \emph{non-lazy} informed batch planners on two kinodynamic benchmarks: a 4D double-integrator model and a 10D linearized Quadrotor. The source code is available here.
tldr: This paper introduces BTIT*, an asymptotically optimal kinodynamic motion planning algorithm for efficient planning in complex state spaces.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的渐近最优的动力学运动规划算法，可在复杂状态空间中实现高效规划。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了双向紧致启发式树（BTIT*），一种渐近最优的基于采样的动力学运动规划算法。该算法整合了任意时间双向启发式搜索（Bi-HS），并确保满足**中间相遇**特性（MMP）与最优性（MM-optimality）。BTIT*是首个在批处理采样运动规划中采用易于评估、支持实时早期终止条件的任意时间中间相遇类算法。实验表明，在两种动力学基准测试场景（4D双积分器模型和10D线性化四旋翼模型）中，相较于代表性的**非惰性**启发式批处理规划器，BTIT*在首次求解时间和收敛速度方面均表现出显著优势。源代码已公开。

title: Safe Human-to-Humanoid Motion Imitation Using Control Barrier Functions
summary: Ensuring operational safety is critical for human-to-humanoid motion imitation. This paper presents a vision-based framework that enables a humanoid robot to imitate human movements while avoiding collisions. Human skeletal keypoints are captured by a single camera and converted into joint angles for motion retargeting. Safety is enforced through a Control Barrier Function (CBF) layer formulated as a Quadratic Program (QP), which filters imitation commands to prevent both self-collisions and human-robot collisions. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for real-time collision-aware motion imitation.
tldr: This paper presents a vision-based framework for safe human-to-humanoid motion imitation using Control Barrier Functions to prevent collisions, validated in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于视觉的框架，通过控制屏障函数防止碰撞，实现人形机器人对人体运动的安全模仿，并在仿真中验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 保证操作安全性对于人形机器人模仿人体运动至关重要。本文提出一种基于视觉的框架，使人形机器人能够在避免碰撞的前提下模仿人体动作。通过单摄像头捕捉人体骨骼关键点，并将其转换为关节角度以实现运动重定向。我们采用基于二次规划的控制屏障函数层来保障安全性，该层通过筛选模仿指令来防止机器人自碰撞与人机碰撞。仿真结果验证了所提框架在实时碰撞感知运动模仿中的有效性。

title: BIND-USBL: Bounding IMU Navigation Drift using USBL in Heterogeneous ASV-AUV Teams
summary: Accurate and continuous localization of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) in GPS-denied environments is a persistent challenge in marine robotics. In the absence of external position fixes, AUVs rely on inertial dead-reckoning, which accumulates unbounded drift due to sensor bias and noise. This paper presents BIND-USBL, a cooperative localization framework in which a fleet of Autonomous Surface Vessels (ASVs) equipped with Ultra-Short Baseline (USBL) acoustic positioning systems provides intermittent fixes to bound AUV dead-reckoning error. The key insight is that long-duration navigation failure is driven not by the accuracy of individual USBL measurements, but by the temporal sparsity and geometric availability of those fixes. BIND-USBL combines a multi-ASV formation model linking survey scale and anchor placement to acoustic coverage, a conflict-graph-based TDMA uplink scheduler for shared-channel servicing, and delayed fusion of received USBL updates with drift-prone dead reckoning. The framework is evaluated in the HoloOcean simulator using heterogeneous ASV-AUV teams executing lawnmower coverage missions. The results show that localization performance is shaped by the interaction of survey scale, acoustic coverage, team composition, and ASV-formation geometry. Further, the spatial-reuse scheduler improves per-AUV fix delivery rate without violating the no-collision constraint, while maintaining low end-to-end fix latency.
tldr: The paper proposes a cooperative localization framework where Autonomous Surface Vessels (ASVs) use acoustic positioning to bound the navigation drift of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs), evaluated through simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种协作定位框架，利用配备声学定位系统的自主水面艇，为自主水下航行器的导航漂移提供边界约束，并通过仿真进行了评估。
summary_zh: 在水下GPS拒止环境中实现自主水下航行器（AUV）的精确持续定位是海洋机器人领域长期存在的挑战。在缺乏外部定位信息的情况下，AUV依赖于惯性推算导航，该方法会因传感器偏差和噪声导致误差无界累积。本文提出了BIND-USBL协同定位框架，该框架通过搭载超短基线（USBL）声学定位系统的自主水面船（ASV）集群，为AUV提供间歇性定位修正以约束其推算误差。核心洞见在于：长期导航失效的关键因素并非单个USBL测量值的精度，而是定位修正的时间稀疏性与几何可用性。BIND-USBL融合了三个关键组件：建立勘测尺度与锚点布置同声学覆盖关联的多ASV编队模型、基于冲突图的共享信道时分多址上行调度器，以及对接收到的USBL数据与易漂移推算导航结果的延迟融合算法。该框架在HoloOcean仿真环境中通过异构ASV-AUV集群执行区域覆盖任务进行评估。实验结果表明，定位性能受到勘测尺度、声学覆盖、团队构成及ASV编队几何形态的交互影响。此外，空间复用调度器在满足无碰撞约束的同时，提升了单AUV的定位修正率，并维持了较低的端到端修正延迟。

title: Minimal Embodiment Enables Efficient Learning of Number Concepts in Robot
summary: Robots are increasingly entering human-interactive scenarios that require understanding of quantity. How intelligent systems acquire abstract numerical concepts from sensorimotor experience remains a fundamental challenge in cognitive science and artificial intelligence. Here we investigate embodied numerical learning using a neural network model trained to perform sequential counting through naturalistic robotic interaction with a Franka Panda manipulator. We demonstrate that embodied models achieve 96.8\% counting accuracy with only 10\% of training data, compared to 60.6\% for vision-only baselines. This advantage persists when visual-motor correspondences are randomized, indicating that embodiment functions as a structural prior that regularizes learning rather than as an information source. The model spontaneously develops biologically plausible representations: number-selective units with logarithmic tuning, mental number line organization, Weber-law scaling, and rotational dynamics encoding numerical magnitude ($r = 0.97$, slope $= 30.6°$/count). The learning trajectory parallels children's developmental progression from subset-knowers to cardinal-principle knowers. These findings demonstrate that minimal embodiment can ground abstract concepts, improve data efficiency, and yield interpretable representations aligned with biological cognition, which may contribute to embodied mathematics tutoring and safety-critical industrial applications.
tldr: An embodied neural network on a Franka Panda manipulator learns numerical concepts (counting) through sensorimotor interaction, showing significant data efficiency gains (96.8% accuracy with 10% data) and developing biologically plausible representations. The work demonstrates embodiment as a structural prior for grounding abstract concepts, relevant to robotics and embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 在Franka Panda机械臂上，具身神经网络通过感觉运动交互学习数字概念（计数），显示出显著的数据效率优势（使用10%数据达到96.8%准确率），并形成生物学上合理的表征。该研究表明具身性是结构化先验，对机器人及具身AI有参考价值。
summary_zh: 随着机器人越来越多地进入需要理解数量信息的人机交互场景，智能系统如何从感觉运动经验中获取抽象的数字概念，仍然是认知科学和人工智能领域的根本性挑战。本研究通过一个神经网络模型探索具身数值学习，该模型在与弗兰卡熊猫机械臂的自然交互中进行序列计数训练。结果表明，具身模型仅使用10%的训练数据即可达到96.8%的计数准确率，而纯视觉基线模型仅达到60.6%。当视觉-运动对应关系被随机化时，该优势依然存在，表明具身性作为结构化先验通过规范学习过程发挥作用，而非单纯提供信息源。该模型自发形成了符合生物认知特征的表示：具有对数调谐特性的数值选择单元、心理数字线组织形式、韦伯定律尺度规律，以及编码数值大小的旋转动力学表征（$r=0.97$，斜率$=30.6°$/计数）。其学习轨迹与儿童从子集认知者到基数原则认知者的发展进程相吻合。这些发现表明，最小限度的具身性即可为抽象概念奠定基础，提升数据效率，并产生与生物认知相契合的可解释表征，这或将为具身数学教学和安全关键型工业应用提供新思路。

title: Inferring World Belief States in Dynamic Real-World Environments
summary: We investigate estimating a human's world belief state using a robot's observations in a dynamic, 3D, and partially observable environment. The methods are grounded in mental model theory, which posits that human decision making, contextual reasoning, situation awareness, and behavior planning draw from an internal simulation or world belief state. When in teams, the mental model also includes a team model of each teammate's beliefs and capabilities, enabling fluent teamwork without the need for constant and explicit communication. In this work we replicate a core component of the team model by inferring a teammate's belief state, or level one situation awareness, as a human-robot team navigates a household environment. We evaluate our methods in a realistic simulation, extend to a real-world robot platform, and demonstrate a downstream application of the belief state through an active assistance semantic reasoning task.
tldr: This paper presents a method for a robot to infer a human teammate's belief state in a dynamic, partially observable household environment, evaluating it in simulation and on a real robot platform with a downstream semantic reasoning application.
tldr_zh: 该研究提出了一种方法，让机器人在动态、部分可观测的家庭环境中推断人类队友的信念状态，并在仿真和真实机器人平台上进行了评估，演示了其在主动协助语义推理任务中的应用。
summary_zh: 我们研究了在动态、三维且部分可观测的环境中，如何利用机器人的观测数据来估计人类的世界信念状态。这些方法基于心智模型理论，该理论认为人类的决策、情境推理、态势感知及行为规划均源于内在的模拟或世界信念状态。在团队协作中，心智模型还包含对每个队友信念与能力的团队模型，从而无需持续且显式的沟通即可实现流畅的团队合作。本研究通过推断队友的信念状态——即一级态势感知水平，在一个家庭环境导航任务中，复制了团队模型的核心组件。我们在高仿真模拟环境中评估了所提方法，并将其扩展至真实机器人平台，通过一个主动辅助语义推理任务展示了信念状态在下游应用中的实际效果。

title: HECTOR: Human-centric Hierarchical Coordination and Supervision of Robotic Fleets under Continual Temporal Tasks
summary: Robotic fleets can be extremely efficient when working concurrently and collaboratively, e.g., for delivery, surveillance, search and rescue. However, it can be demanding or even impractical for an operator to directly control each robot. Thus, autonomy of the fleet and its online interaction with the operator are both essential, particularly in dynamic and partially unknown environments. The operator might need to add new tasks, cancel some tasks, change priorities and modify planning results. How to design the procedure for these interactions and efficient algorithms to fulfill these needs have been mostly neglected in the related literature. Thus, this work proposes a human-centric coordination and supervision scheme (HECTOR) for large-scale robotic fleets under continual and uncertain temporal tasks. It consists of three hierarchical layers: (I) the bidirectional and multimodal protocol of online human-fleet interaction, where the operator interacts with and supervises the whole fleet; (II) the rolling assignment of currently-known tasks to teams within a certain horizon, and (III) the dynamic coordination within a team given the detected subtasks during online execution. The overall mission can be as general as temporal logic formulas over collaborative actions. Such hierarchical structure allows human interaction and supervision at different granularities and triggering conditions, to both improve computational efficiency and reduce human effort. Extensive human-in-the-loop simulations are performed over heterogeneous fleets under various temporal tasks and environmental uncertainties.
tldr: Proposes a hierarchical human-fleet interaction framework (HECTOR) for coordinating large robotic fleets under dynamic, uncertain temporal tasks, enabling operator supervision at different levels through multimodal interaction.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个用于协调大规模机器人集群的、分层的人机交互框架HECTOR，旨在让操作员能够通过多模态交互，在不同粒度上监督和管理执行动态、不确定时序任务的机器人团队。
summary_zh: 大规模机器人集群在协同工作时能够实现极高效率，例如在物流配送、区域监控、搜索救援等场景中。然而，要求操作员直接控制每个机器人往往难度较大甚至难以实现。因此，集群的自主性及其与操作员的在线交互能力至关重要，尤其在动态且部分未知的环境中。操作员可能需要随时添加新任务、取消部分任务、调整优先级或修改规划结果。现有研究大多忽视了如何设计此类交互流程及相应的高效算法来满足这些需求。为此，本文提出一种面向持续不确定时序任务下大规模机器人集群的人本协调与监控框架（HECTOR）。该框架包含三个层次：（I）双向多模态在线人机交互协议，支持操作员对整个集群进行交互与监控；（II）在特定时间窗口内对已知任务进行滚动式团队分配；（III）在线执行过程中根据检测到的子任务实现团队内部动态协调。整体任务可泛化为基于协同动作的时序逻辑表达式。这种分层结构允许操作员在不同粒度与触发条件下进行交互监控，既提升了计算效率，又减少了人工操作负担。研究通过大量人在环仿真实验，验证了该框架在异构机器人集群、多种时序任务及环境不确定性下的有效性。

title: Angle-based Localization and Rigidity Maintenance Control for Multi-Robot Networks
summary: In this work, we study angle-based localization and rigidity maintenance control for multi-robot networks under sensing constraints. We establish the first equivalence between angle rigidity and bearing rigidity considering \textit{directed} sensing graphs and \textit{body-frame} bearing measurements in both $2$ and $3$-\textit{dimensional space}. In particular, we demonstrate that a framework in $\mathrm{SE}(d)$ is infinitesimally bearing rigid if and only if it is infinitesimally angle rigid and each robot obtains at least $d-1$ bearing measurements ($d \in \{2, 3\}$). Building on these findings, this paper proposes a distributed angle-based localization scheme and establishes local exponential stability under switching sensing graphs, requiring only infinitesimal angle rigidity across the visited topologies. Then, since angle rigidity strongly depends on the robots' spatial configuration, we investigate rigidity maintenance control. The \textit{angle rigidity eigenvalue} is presented as a metric for the degree of rigidity. A decentralized gradient-based controller capable of executing mission-specific commands while maintaining a sufficient level of angle rigidity is proposed. Simulations were conducted to evaluate the scheme's effectiveness and practicality.
tldr: This paper presents a distributed angle-based localization and rigidity maintenance control scheme for multi-robot networks under sensing constraints, establishing equivalence between angle and bearing rigidity for directed sensing graphs.
tldr_zh: 本文针对多机器人网络提出了分布式角度定位和刚度保持控制方案，建立了有向感知图下角度刚度和朝向刚度的等效关系。
summary_zh: 本文研究了传感约束下的多机器人网络角度定位与刚性保持控制。针对二维与三维空间中**有向**传感图及**体坐标系**方位测量，我们首次建立了角度刚性与方位刚性之间的等价关系。具体而言，我们证明了在$\mathrm{SE}(d)$空间（$d \in \{2, 3\}$）中，一个框架是无限小方位刚性的当且仅当其具有无限小角度刚性，且每个机器人至少获得$d-1$个方位测量。基于这些发现，本文提出了一种分布式角度定位方案，并在切换传感图下建立了局部指数稳定性，该方案仅要求拓扑遍历过程中保持无限小角度刚性。随后，由于角度刚性高度依赖机器人的空间构型，我们进一步研究了刚性保持控制。引入**角度刚性特征值**作为刚性程度的度量指标，提出一种基于梯度的分散控制器，该控制器能够在执行特定任务指令的同时维持足够的角度刚性水平。最后通过仿真验证了方案的有效性与实用性。

title: Dyadic Partnership(DP): A Missing Link Towards Full Autonomy in Medical Robotics
summary: For the past decades medical robotic solutions were mostly based on the concept of tele-manipulation. While their design was extremely intelligent, allowing for better access, improved dexterity, reduced tremor, and improved imaging, their intelligence was limited. They therefore left cognition and decision making to the surgeon. As medical robotics advances towards high-level autonomy, the scientific community needs to explore the required pathway towards partial and full autonomy. Here, we introduce the concept of Dyadic Partnership(DP), a new paradigm in which robots and clinicians engage in intelligent, expert interaction and collaboration. The Dyadic Partners would discuss and agree on decisions and actions during their dynamic and interactive collaboration relying also on intuitive advanced media using generative AI, such as a world model, and advanced multi-modal visualization. This article outlines the foundational components needed to enable such systems, including foundation models for clinical intelligence, multi-modal intent recognition, co-learning frameworks, advanced visualization, and explainable, trust-aware interaction. We further discuss key challenges such as data scarcity, lack of standardization, and ethical acceptance. Dyadic partnership is introduced and is positioned as a powerful yet achievable, acceptable milestone offering a promising pathway toward safer, more intuitive collaboration and a gradual transition to full autonomy across diverse clinical settings.
tldr: Introduces Dyadic Partnership (DP), a collaborative paradigm for medical robotics where robots and surgeons interactively discuss and decide on actions, using generative AI and world models, as a step towards full autonomy. It outlines required technical components and challenges for implementing such systems.
tldr_zh: 介绍了医疗机器人中的二元伙伴关系（DP），这是一种新的协作范式，机器人与外科医生使用生成式AI和世界模型进行交互式讨论和决策，作为迈向完全自主的一步。文章概述了实现此类系统所需的技术组件和挑战。
summary_zh: 过去几十年来，医疗机器人解决方案大多基于遥操作理念。尽管其设计极具智慧，能够实现更优的术野可达性、更高的操作灵巧度、更稳定的防抖性能以及更清晰的成像效果，但其智能水平仍存在局限。因此，这类系统将认知与决策任务完全交由外科医生承担。随着医疗机器人技术向高级自主化方向发展，科学界亟需探索实现部分乃至完全自主化的可行路径。本文提出“双元协作”新范式，在此框架下机器人系统与临床医生将通过智能化的专家级交互开展协同合作。双方基于生成式人工智能的直观先进媒介（如世界模型）与多模态可视化技术，在动态交互协作中对决策与行动方案进行讨论并达成共识。本文系统阐述了实现该体系所需的基础组件，包括临床智能基础模型、多模态意图识别、协同学习框架、先进可视化技术及可解释的信任感知交互机制。同时深入探讨了数据稀缺性、标准缺失、伦理接受度等关键挑战。双元协作作为一种强大而可实现的里程碑式方案，为实现更安全、更直观的人机协同及不同临床场景下逐步过渡至完全自主化提供了具有前景的技术路径。

title: Efficient Emotion-Aware Iconic Gesture Prediction for Robot Co-Speech
summary: Co-speech gestures increase engagement and improve speech understanding. Most data-driven robot systems generate rhythmic beat-like motion, yet few integrate semantic emphasis. To address this, we propose a lightweight transformer that derives iconic gesture placement and intensity from text and emotion alone, requiring no audio input at inference time. The model outperforms GPT-4o in both semantic gesture placement classification and intensity regression on the BEAT2 dataset, while remaining computationally compact and suitable for real-time deployment on embodied agents.
tldr: Proposes a lightweight transformer model to generate semantically meaningful iconic gestures for robots based on text and emotion, outperforming GPT-4o on a gesture dataset and designed for real-time use on embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 提出一种轻量级Transformer模型，仅根据文本和情感为机器人生成具有语义意义的标志性手势，在BEAT2数据集上表现优于GPT-4o，并适合在具身智能体上实时部署。
summary_zh: 伴随语音手势能增强互动并提升言语理解。当前多数数据驱动的机器人系统生成的只是节奏性的节拍式动作，但很少融入语义强调。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种轻量级Transformer模型，它仅依据文本和情感信息即可生成具象化手势的位置与强度，在推理过程中无需音频输入。在BEAT2数据集上，该模型在语义手势位置分类和强度回归任务中均优于GPT-4o，同时保持计算紧凑性，适合在具身智能体上实时部署。

title: EmbodiedGovBench: A Benchmark for Governance, Recovery, and Upgrade Safety in Embodied Agent Systems
summary: Recent progress in embodied AI has produced a growing ecosystem of robot policies, foundation models, and modular runtimes. However, current evaluation remains dominated by task success metrics such as completion rate or manipulation accuracy. These metrics leave a critical gap: they do not measure whether embodied systems are governable -- whether they respect capability boundaries, enforce policies, recover safely, maintain audit trails, and respond to human oversight. We present EmbodiedGovBench, a benchmark for governance-oriented evaluation of embodied agent systems. Rather than asking only whether a robot can complete a task, EmbodiedGovBench evaluates whether the system remains controllable, policy-bounded, recoverable, auditable, and evolution-safe under realistic perturbations. The benchmark covers seven governance dimensions: unauthorized capability invocation, runtime drift robustness, recovery success, policy portability, version upgrade safety, human override responsiveness, and audit completeness. We define a benchmark structure spanning single-robot and fleet settings, with scenario templates, perturbation operators, governance metrics, and baseline evaluation protocols. We describe how the benchmark can be instantiated over embodied capability runtimes with modular interfaces and contract-aware upgrade workflows. Our analysis suggests that embodied governance should become a first-class evaluation target. EmbodiedGovBench provides the initial measurement framework for that shift.
tldr: This paper introduces EmbodiedGovBench, a benchmark for evaluating governance, safety, and controllability in embodied AI and robotic systems, focusing on dimensions like policy enforcement and recovery.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了EmbodiedGovBench，一个用于评估具身AI和机器人系统中治理、安全性和可控性的基准，重点关注策略执行和恢复等维度。
summary_zh: 近年来，具身智能领域的发展催生了日益丰富的机器人策略、基础模型与模块化运行时生态系统。然而，当前评估体系仍以任务成功率指标为主导，如任务完成率或操作精度。这些指标存在一个关键缺陷：它们无法衡量具身系统是否具备可治理性——即系统能否遵循能力边界、执行策略、安全恢复运行、维护审计记录并响应人类监管。本研究提出EmbodiedGovBench，一个面向具身智能体系统治理性评估的基准测试。该基准不仅关注机器人能否完成任务，更着重评估系统在现实扰动下是否保持可控性、策略约束性、可恢复性、可审计性及进化安全性。基准涵盖七大治理维度：未授权能力调用防护、运行时偏移鲁棒性、恢复成功率、策略可移植性、版本升级安全性、人工干预响应能力及审计完整性。我们定义了覆盖单机器人与集群场景的基准架构，包含场景模板、扰动算子、治理指标与基线评估协议，并阐述了该基准如何通过模块化接口与合约感知的升级工作流在具身能力运行时中实例化。分析表明，具身系统治理应成为核心评估目标，而EmbodiedGovBench为这一转变提供了初步的测量框架。

title: Ψ-Map: Panoptic Surface Integrated Mapping Enables Real2Sim Transfer
summary: Open-vocabulary panoptic reconstruction is essential for advanced robotics perception and simulation. However, existing methods based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) often struggle to simultaneously achieve geometric accuracy, coherent panoptic understanding, and real-time inference frequency in large-scale scenes. In this paper, we propose a comprehensive framework that integrates geometric reinforcement, end-to-end panoptic learning, and efficient rendering. First, to ensure physical realism in large-scale environments, we leverage LiDAR data to construct plane-constrained multimodal Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) and employ 2D Gaussian surfels as the map representation, enabling high-precision surface alignment and continuous geometric supervision. Building upon this, to overcome the error accumulation and cumbersome cross-frame association inherent in traditional multi-stage panoptic segmentation pipelines, we design a query-guided end-to-end learning architecture. By utilizing a local cross-attention mechanism within the view frustum, the system lifts 2D mask features directly into 3D space, achieving globally consistent panoptic understanding. Finally, addressing the computational bottlenecks caused by high-dimensional semantic features, we introduce Precise Tile Intersection and a Top-K Hard Selection strategy to optimize the rendering pipeline. Experimental results demonstrate that our system achieves superior geometric and panoptic reconstruction quality in large-scale scenes while maintaining an inference rate exceeding 40 FPS, meeting the real-time requirements of robotic control loops.
tldr: A method for open-vocabulary panoptic reconstruction using LiDAR-constrained Gaussian surfels and end-to-end learning, achieving real-time performance for robotic perception.
tldr_zh: 一种使用LiDAR约束的高斯面元与端到端学习的开放词汇全景重建方法，可实现机器人感知的实时性能。
summary_zh: 开放词汇全景重建对于高级机器人感知与仿真至关重要。然而，现有基于三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的方法在大规模场景中往往难以同时实现几何精度、连贯的全景理解与实时推理频率。本文提出一个集成几何增强、端到端全景学习和高效渲染的综合框架。首先，为保障大规模环境中的物理真实感，我们利用激光雷达数据构建平面约束的多模态高斯混合模型，并采用二维高斯面元作为地图表示，实现高精度表面对齐与连续性几何监督。在此基础上，为克服传统多阶段全景分割流程固有的误差累积与跨帧关联繁琐问题，我们设计了一种查询引导的端到端学习架构。通过视锥体内局部交叉注意力机制，系统将二维掩码特征直接提升至三维空间，达成全局一致的全景理解。最后，针对高维语义特征带来的计算瓶颈，我们引入精确图块相交与Top-K硬选择策略以优化渲染管线。实验结果表明，本系统在大规模场景中实现了卓越的几何与全景重建质量，同时保持超过40FPS的推理速率，满足机器人控制回路的实时性需求。

title: Fast-SegSim: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Segmentation for Robotics in Simulation
summary: Open-vocabulary panoptic reconstruction is crucial for advanced robotics and simulation. However, existing 3D reconstruction methods, such as NeRF or Gaussian Splatting variants, often struggle to achieve the real-time inference frequency required by robotic control loops. Existing methods incur prohibitive latency when processing the high-dimensional features required for robust open-vocabulary segmentation. We propose Fast-SegSim, a novel, simple, and end-to-end framework built upon 2D Gaussian Splatting, designed to realize real-time, high-fidelity, and 3D-consistent open-vocabulary segmentation reconstruction. Our core contribution is a highly optimized rendering pipeline that specifically addresses the computational bottleneck of high-channel segmentation feature accumulation. We introduce two key optimizations: Precise Tile Intersection to reduce rasterization redundancy, and a novel Top-K Hard Selection strategy. This strategy leverages the geometric sparsity inherent in the 2D Gaussian representation to greatly simplify feature accumulation and alleviate bandwidth limitations, achieving render rates exceeding 40 FPS. Fast-SegSim provides critical value in robotic applications: it serves both as a high-frequency sensor input for simulation platforms like Gazebo, and its 3D-consistent outputs provide essential multi-view 'ground truth' labels for fine-tuning downstream perception tasks. We demonstrate this utility by using the generated labels to fine-tune the perception module in object goal navigation, successfully doubling the navigation success rate. Our superior rendering speed and practical utility underscore Fast-SegSim's potential to bridge the sim-to-real gap.
tldr: This paper presents Fast-SegSim, a method for real-time open-vocabulary 3D segmentation in simulation, built upon 2D Gaussian Splatting with novel optimizations, and demonstrates its value for robotic applications like sensor input and perception fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Fast-SegSim，一种基于2D高斯溅射的实时开放词汇3D分割方法，具有新颖的优化技术，并展示了其在机器人应用中作为传感器输入和感知微调的价值。
summary_zh: 开放式词汇全景重建对于高级机器人技术和仿真至关重要。然而，现有三维重建方法（如NeRF或高斯泼溅变体）往往难以达到机器人控制回路所需的实时推理频率。在处理稳健开放式词汇分割所需的高维特征时，现有方法会产生极高的延迟。我们提出Fast-SegSim——一个基于二维高斯泼溅构建的新型、简洁且端到端的框架，旨在实现实时、高保真且三维一致的开放式词汇分割重建。我们的核心贡献是高度优化的渲染管线，专门针对高通道分割特征累积的计算瓶颈。我们引入两项关键优化：通过精确图块交叠减少栅格化冗余，以及新颖的Top-K硬选择策略。该策略利用二维高斯表示固有的几何稀疏性，极大简化了特征累积过程并缓解了带宽限制，实现了超过40 FPS的渲染速率。Fast-SegSim在机器人应用中具有重要价值：既可作为Gazebo等仿真平台的高频传感器输入，其三维一致性输出也为微调下游感知任务提供了必需的多视角“真实标注”标签。我们通过将生成的标签用于目标导航任务中感知模块的微调，成功将导航成功率提升一倍，验证了该框架的实用性。卓越的渲染速度与实用价值彰显了Fast-SegSim在弥合仿真与现实差距方面的潜力。

title: EgoFun3D: Modeling Interactive Objects from Egocentric Videos using Function Templates
summary: We present EgoFun3D, a coordinated task formulation, dataset, and benchmark for modeling interactive 3D objects from egocentric videos. Interactive objects are of high interest for embodied AI but scarce, making modeling from readily available real-world videos valuable. Our task focuses on obtaining simulation-ready interactive 3D objects from egocentric video input. While prior work largely focuses on articulations, we capture general cross-part functional mappings (e.g., rotation of stove knob controls stove burner temperature) through function templates, a structured computational representation. Function templates enable precise evaluation and direct compilation into executable code across simulation platforms. To enable comprehensive benchmarking, we introduce a dataset of 271 egocentric videos featuring challenging real-world interactions with paired 3D geometry, segmentation over 2D and 3D, articulation and function template annotations. To tackle the task, we propose a 4-stage pipeline consisting of: 2D part segmentation, reconstruction, articulation estimation, and function template inference. Comprehensive benchmarking shows that the task is challenging for off-the-shelf methods, highlighting avenues for future work.
tldr: EgoFun3D is a method for creating simulation-ready 3D models of interactive objects from egocentric videos, using a structured representation called 'function templates' to capture general functional relationships. It introduces a new dataset and benchmark specifically for this task, which is challenging for current off-the-shelf methods.
tldr_zh: EgoFun3D是一种从自我中心视频中创建可用于仿真的交互式3D对象模型的方法，它使用一种名为‘功能模板’的结构化表示来捕捉通用的功能关系。该方法为这一任务引入了一个新的数据集和基准，该任务对当前的现成方法具有挑战性。
summary_zh: 本文提出EgoFun3D——一个用于从第一人称视频中建模交互式三维物体的协同任务框架、数据集与基准测试平台。交互式物体在具身人工智能领域具有重要价值，但相关数据稀缺，这使得利用易获取的真实世界视频进行建模具有重要意义。我们的任务聚焦于从第一人称视频输入中获取可直接用于仿真的交互式三维物体。现有研究多集中于关节结构建模，而本文通过函数模板（一种结构化计算表示）捕捉更广泛的跨部件功能映射关系（例如旋钮转动控制炉灶燃烧器温度）。函数模板支持精确评估，并能直接编译为跨仿真平台的可执行代码。为建立全面基准测试，我们构建了一个包含271段第一人称视频的数据集，涵盖具有挑战性的真实世界交互场景，同时提供配对的二维/三维几何分割、关节结构标注与函数模板标注。针对该任务，我们提出包含四个阶段的处理流程：二维部件分割、三维重建、关节结构估计与函数模板推断。综合基准测试表明，当前通用方法在此任务上仍面临挑战，这为未来研究指明了方向。

title: GeomPrompt: Geometric Prompt Learning for RGB-D Semantic Segmentation Under Missing and Degraded Depth
summary: Multimodal perception systems for robotics and embodied AI often assume reliable RGB-D sensing, but in practice, depth is frequently missing, noisy, or corrupted. We thus present GeomPrompt, a lightweight cross-modal adaptation module that synthesizes a task-driven geometric prompt from RGB alone for the fourth channel of a frozen RGB-D semantic segmentation model, without depth supervision. We further introduce GeomPrompt-Recovery, an adaptation module that compensates for degraded depth by predicting the fourth channel correction relevant for the frozen segmenter. Both modules are trained solely with downstream segmentation supervision, enabling recovery of the geometric prior useful for segmentation, rather than estimating depth signals. On SUN RGB-D, GeomPrompt improves over RGB-only inference by +6.1 mIoU on DFormer and +3.0 mIoU on GeminiFusion, while remaining competitive with strong monocular depth estimators. For degraded depth, GeomPrompt-Recovery consistently improves robustness, yielding gains up to +3.6 mIoU under severe depth corruptions. GeomPrompt is also substantially more efficient than monocular depth baselines, reaching 7.8 ms latency versus 38.3 ms and 71.9 ms. These results suggest that task-driven geometric prompting is an efficient mechanism for cross-modal compensation under missing and degraded depth inputs in RGB-D perception.
tldr: The paper introduces GeomPrompt, a method for geometric prompting to maintain RGB-D semantic segmentation performance when depth is missing or degraded, with applications in robotics and embodied AI perception.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GeomPrompt，一种几何提示学习方法，用于在深度数据缺失或退化时维持RGB-D语义分割的性能，适用于机器人和具身智能感知系统。
summary_zh: 机器人与具身人工智能的多模态感知系统通常假定RGB-D传感可靠，但在实践中深度信息常存在缺失、噪声或损坏问题。为此，我们提出GeomPrompt——一种轻量级跨模态适配模块，仅通过RGB图像即可为冻结的RGB-D语义分割模型的第四通道合成任务驱动的几何提示，且无需深度监督。我们还进一步提出GeomPrompt-Recovery适配模块，通过预测冻结分割器所需的第四通道修正值来补偿退化的深度信息。两个模块均仅通过下游分割监督进行训练，从而恢复对分割有用的几何先验，而非直接估计深度信号。在SUN RGB-D数据集上，GeomPrompt使DFormer模型的纯RGB推理性能提升+6.1 mIoU，GeminiFusion模型提升+3.0 mIoU，同时保持与强单目深度估计方法的竞争力。对于退化深度数据，GeomPrompt-Recovery持续提升鲁棒性，在深度严重损坏情况下最高可获得+3.6 mIoU增益。GeomPrompt的计算效率也显著优于单目深度基准方法，延迟时间仅为7.8毫秒，而对比方法分别为38.3毫秒和71.9毫秒。这些结果表明，在RGB-D感知中面临深度信息缺失或退化时，任务驱动的几何提示是一种高效的跨模态补偿机制。

title: HO-Flow: Generalizable Hand-Object Interaction Generation with Latent Flow Matching
summary: Generating realistic 3D hand-object interactions (HOI) is a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics, requiring both temporal coherence and high-fidelity physical plausibility. Existing methods remain limited in their ability to learn expressive motion representations for generation and perform temporal reasoning. In this paper, we present HO-Flow, a framework for synthesizing realistic hand-object motion sequences from texts and canoncial 3D objects. HO-Flow first employs an interaction-aware variational autoencoder to encode sequences of hand and object motions into a unified latent manifold by incorporating hand and object kinematics, enabling the representation to capture rich interaction dynamics. It then leverages a masked flow matching model that combines auto-regressive temporal reasoning with continuous latent generation, improving temporal coherence. To further enhance generalization, HO-Flow predicts object motions relative to the initial frame, enabling effective pre-training on large-scale synthetic data. Experiments on the GRAB, OakInk, and DexYCB benchmarks demonstrate that HO-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both physical plausibility and motion diversity for interaction motion synthesis.
tldr: HO-Flow is a framework for generating realistic 3D hand-object interaction sequences from text and 3D object models, focusing on physical plausibility and temporal coherence. It uses a variational autoencoder for latent representation and flow matching for generation.
tldr_zh: HO-Flow是一个用于从文本和3D物体模型生成物理合理、时序连贯的3D手-物交互序列的框架，采用变分自编码器进行潜在表示，并利用流匹配进行生成。
summary_zh: 生成真实的手-物体交互（HOI）是计算机视觉和机器人学中的一个基本挑战，它需要同时具备时间连贯性和高保真的物理合理性。现有方法在学习用于生成的富有表现力的运动表示及进行时间推理方面仍存在局限性。本文提出了一种从文本和规范3D物体中合成真实手-物体运动序列的框架——HO-Flow。该框架首先采用一种交互感知的变分自编码器，通过结合手部和物体的运动学信息，将手与物体的运动序列编码到一个统一的潜在流形中，使得该表示能够捕捉丰富的交互动态。随后，HO-Flow利用一个结合了自回归时间推理与连续潜在生成的掩码流匹配模型，以提升时间连贯性。为进一步增强泛化能力，HO-Flow通过预测物体相对于初始帧的运动，实现了在大规模合成数据上的有效预训练。在GRAB、OakInk和DexYCB基准数据集上的实验表明，HO-Flow在交互运动合成方面，无论在物理合理性还是运动多样性上，均达到了最先进的性能水平。

title: LEADER: Learning Reliable Local-to-Global Correspondences for LiDAR Relocalization
summary: LiDAR relocalization has attracted increasing attention as it can deliver accurate 6-DoF pose estimation in complex 3D environments. Recent learning-based regression methods offer efficient solutions by directly predicting global poses without the need for explicit map storage. However, these methods often struggle in challenging scenes due to their equal treatment of all predicted points, which is vulnerable to noise and outliers. In this paper, we propose LEADER, a robust LiDAR-based relocalization framework enhanced by a simple, yet effective geometric encoder.
